shortDescription: Manages the update and upgrade of the VIOS from the HMC

options.name: attributes
options.description: Configuration parameters required for VIOS update and upgrade.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IP address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired build state of the target VIOS. C(facts) does not change anything on the VIOS and returns current version of VIOS. C(updated) ensures the target VIOS is updated with given installation ISO image. C(upgraded) ensures the target VIOS is upgraded with given upgrade files.
